pyramiding_rule: Strict prohibition against averaging down or scaling into trades in the direction of an active adverse wick; new scale-ins require confirmed momentum breakout on 5M closing prices.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Mandatory Average True Range (ATR) expansion filter and Order Flow Imbalance (OFI) check: block entries if volume is below the 20-period moving average.
profit_harvest_threshold: Trigger trailing stops instantly when open profit hits +$10.00 to prevent floating gains from evaporating into broker commissions and negative finishes.
